name: LVBench
intro: LVBench 是 ICCV 2025 的极长视频理解基准。论文从 500 个至少 30 分钟的 YouTube 候选中按五项规则筛得 103 个视频，采用三阶段专业标注、编辑质控和 GLM-4/GPT-4 纯文本泄漏门控，最终发布 1,549 道四选一题。
build_method: 五规则长视频筛选, 三阶段专业人工标注, 编辑质控, 双模型纯文本泄漏门控
metric: 总体精确选项准确率, 六项多标签能力准确率, 论文单列视频类别与人类分析
eval_feature: 非原生模型固定帧采样, 原生模型 1 FPS, 论文响应解析与公开精确评分分离, 不含音频
scale: 论文报告 103 个视频 / 117 小时 / 1,549 道题；固定 JSONL 含 103 条视频记录与 1,549 个嵌套 QA
build_method_en: Five-rule Long-video Screening, Three-stage Professional Annotation, Editorial QC, Dual-model Text-only Leakage Gate
eval_feature_en: Fixed-frame Sampling for Non-native Models, 1 FPS for Native Models, Paper Parsing Separated from Released Exact Scoring, No Audio
intro_en: LVBench is an ICCV 2025 extreme-long-video understanding benchmark. Five rules reduce 500 YouTube candidates of at least 30 minutes to 103 videos. Three-stage professional annotation, editorial quality control, and a GLM-4/GPT-4 text-only leakage gate produce 1,549 four-choice questions.
scale_en: Paper: 103 videos / 117 hours / 1,549 questions; pinned JSONL: 103 video records with 1,549 nested QA
metric_en: Overall Exact-choice Accuracy, Six Multi-label Capability Accuracies, Paper-only Video-category and Human Analyses

drawio_evidence_note: Primary evidence is the ICCV 2025 paper and arXiv:2406.08035v3, revised 2025-08-09. Reproducibility pins are Git 518df47219862534dad39fa1373b4e7c862a4cd5, Hugging Face dataset 0caedb92002cc268bad486449e551c76f0485670, static leaderboard source 07fdecb16a828ff6c4d8d0e68c2e49ca20b2890d, and leaderboard Space 67b3b779bf7b5323ef517f3f49c150fb31486916. The code repository has no release or tag.
drawio_scoring_note: The paper prompt asks for the letter of one of four choices without explanation. Paper v3 states regex extraction followed by an unnamed LLM fallback; v1 and v2 name GLM-4. No system prompt, fallback prompt, generation parameters, or complete inference harness are public. The released repository instead expects a pre-normalized uid-to-answer JSON and uses exact string equality. Its polish_answer helper is not called by the scorer. Missing UIDs are silently excluded, so Overall equals correct divided by submitted known UIDs and reaches a denominator of 1,549 only for a complete submission. Each multi-label item contributes to every tagged capability denominator. test_acc writes 0–1 fractions for Overall, ER, EU, KIR, TG, Rea, and Sum; the Space multiplies them by 100 for display. Video-category scores and the 94.4 percent human result are paper analyses, not outputs of the released scorer.
drawio_release_drift_note: The construction count remains 103 videos and 1,549 QA across paper versions, while experiments expand from 8 baseline models in v1 to 15 in v2 and 26 in v3. The paper reports 117 hours, a 4,101-second mean, and a minimum 720p screen. The pinned JSONL metadata sums to 115.532 hours with a 4,038-second mean; 16 of 103 recorded heights are below 720p and four videos exceed two hours. The fixed release has 26 canonical capability combinations, but after filtering only 25 of 103 videos retain all six capabilities. Old THUDM repository URLs redirect to zai-org. These are explicit paper-versus-artifact or version boundaries, not replacements for the paper-reported construction contract.
drawio_artifact_boundary_note: The public, ungated artifact contains 103 top-level video records and 1,549 unique nested QA with uid, question, A–D answer, multi-label question_type, and time_reference. The paper recommends no train/dev/test split and reserves the whole set for evaluation and testing. Hugging Face Viewer train=7 is an ImageFolder mis-detection of seven files under docs/images and is not a benchmark split. Annotations, metadata, and scripts are public, but original videos are not hosted: consumers reconstruct YouTube URLs from IDs, and retained copies can be supplied only with creator permission. The paper, card, and README declare CC BY-NC-SA-4.0 and noncommercial use, while the dataset LICENSE file contains unresolved Apache/CC merge markers and the code repository has no top-level license. Openness is therefore partly public.
drawio_leaderboard_note: The official static leaderboard is available at https://lvbench.github.io/#leaderboard and reports Overall plus ER, EU, KIR, TG, Rea, and Sum. It is a different time snapshot from the v3 paper table. The official Hugging Face submission Space was in runtime error when checked on 2026-07-21 because it could not authenticate to the LVBench_submission dataset. Its source trusts uploaded aggregate metric values and writes them to CSV after multiplying by 100; it does not re-evaluate per-question predictions.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with the ICCV 2025 paper, arXiv:2406.08035v3, Git revision 518df47219862534dad39fa1373b4e7c862a4cd5, Hugging Face dataset revision 0caedb92002cc268bad486449e551c76f0485670, static leaderboard revision 07fdecb16a828ff6c4d8d0e68c2e49ca20b2890d, and Space revision 67b3b779bf7b5323ef517f3f49c150fb31486916. The main flow preserves the 500-candidate YouTube pool, all five video filters, the paper-reported 103-video corpus, professional annotation, three annotation stages, editorial quality control, the GLM-4/GPT-4 text-only leakage gate, and the 1,549-question evaluation release. The 24-questions-per-hour figure belongs to pre-filter authoring, six-skill coverage is an initial per-video instruction rather than a final-release guarantee, and the six video categories are not balanced. Evaluation branches non-native fixed-frame sampling from native 1 FPS processing, then separates the paper-described regex-plus-LLM response parser from the released exact-match scorer. Version, released-data, licensing, external-video, misleading Hugging Face Viewer, and leaderboard-service boundaries remain side evidence rather than being folded into the construction path.
